records.title: Limon quadrangle geologic map data

rights.text: Retain source attribution and source-specific terms; discovery does not grant redistribution rights or data admission.

records.description: Digital reproduction released in 2022 of the 1980 Limon quadrangle map, covering eastern Colorado and western Kansas. Includes geologic polygons, fossil points, faunal-zone lines and Dakota Sandstone structure contours. Source map date is separate from digitization. ScienceBase metadata and exact ZIP response sizes were checked using TLS on 2026-10-08; ZIP contents and georeferencing have not been inspected locally.

records.title: Lamar quadrangle geologic map data

rights.text: Retain source attribution and source-specific terms; discovery does not grant redistribution rights or data admission.

records.description: Digital geologic data released in 2022 from the 1976 Lamar quadrangle map, covering eastern Colorado and western Kansas. Includes mapped geologic units, contacts, faults, ammonite fossils and source-description tables. ScienceBase metadata and exact ZIP response sizes were checked using TLS on 2026-10-08; archive contents have not been inspected locally and are not an installed map layer.

records.title: Cooperative National Geologic Map — Earth surface

rights.text: The official version 2 ArcGIS item states public domain and requests source citation. Retain MapSourceID/DataSources provenance; private capture does not establish source admission, review, display readiness or release.

records.description: Interpreted earth surface product in the Cooperative National Geologic Map. Initial publication 2025; version 2 released September 3, 2026. The offered GeMS ZIP is a full national archive, not a Kansas-only subset. The exact download returned verified-TLS HTTP 200 and Content-Length on October 8, 2026; only response headers were read. HEAD attempts timed out and archive contents are uninspected. The separate map-unit service supports bounded source previews. These thematic interpretations are not a continuous three-dimensional geology model; retain MapSourceID and linked DataSources citations and source-specific mapping limitations.
